objective: Produce one canonical non-dimensional acquisition performance summary from an explicit relationship cohort, attributed relationship economics views, and durable outcome facts.

semantics.economics: sum canonical relationship economics directly by currency
semantics.outcomes: reuse canonical global durable outcome analytics
semantics.rates: reuse canonical exact quote and bind fractions
semantics.costPerOutcome: reuse canonical global acquisition cost per outcome

rules: Relationship identities are canonically validated and deduplicated preserving first occurrence order.
Exactly one attributed economics view is required for every canonical cohort relationship.
Views outside the explicit cohort are rejected.
Attributed view relationshipId must match its relationship analytics relationshipId.
Relationship analytics must carry the canonical acquisition analytics projection version.
Overall economics are totaled directly from canonical relationship currency projections rather than reconstructed from a dimension bucket.
Currency totals are sorted deterministically by currency.
Every economic amount remains an integer minor-unit value.
Signed commission and contribution values remain signed.
Durable quote and bind attainment are computed only by the canonical outcome analytics owner.
Exact quote and bind rates are computed only by the canonical outcome rate owner.
Acquisition cost per quote and bind is computed only by the canonical cost-per-outcome owner.
One relationship denominator is cross-checked across overall economics, outcomes, rates, and cost-per-outcome.

No dimensional bucketing, SQL, persistence read, persistence mutation, rate division, floating-point percentage, currency conversion, dashboard UI, deployment, or telephony activation occurs in this layer.
explicitlyDeferred: integration into lifetime created-at performance snapshot
